description: Arcade.dev LLM tools for Microsoft Word

tools.name: CreateDocument
tools.description:
Create a new Word document in OneDrive (4MB upload limit).

Optionally include text content.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: File name without extension, or with .docx. The .docx extension is normalized.

parameters.name: text_content
parameters.description: Optional text content to include in the new document. If omitted, an empty document is created.

parameters.name: folder_id
parameters.description: Optional parent folder ID. If omitted, the document is created in the root.

parameters.name: conflict_behavior
parameters.description: Optional conflict behavior when a file with the same name exists. One of: fail, rename, replace.

text_content.value: This document outlines the key objectives and deliverables for the Q3 2024 project proposal. Please review and provide feedback by end of week.

tools.name: GetDocument
tools.description:
Get a Word document's metadata and content (`.docx` only).

Returns the document content as Markdown by default.
Returns only metadata when metadata_only is True.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The ID of the Word document to retrieve.

parameters.name: drive_id
parameters.description: Optional drive ID for shared items. If omitted, uses the user's default drive.

parameters.name: metadata_only
parameters.description: If True, return only the document metadata without downloading the content. Defaults to False.

output.description: The Word document metadata and optionally its content.

tools.name: InsertTextAtEnd
tools.description: Append text to the end of a Word document (supports only `.docx`, 4MB limit).

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The ID of the Word document to update.

parameters.name: text_content
parameters.description: The text content to append to the document.

parameters.name: drive_id
parameters.description: Optional drive ID for shared items. If omitted, uses the user's default drive.

text_content.value: This is the additional text being appended to the end of the document.

summary:
## Microsoft Word Toolkit

Arcade's Microsoft Word toolkit enables LLMs to create, read, and edit Word documents stored in OneDrive via the Microsoft Graph API.

## Capabilities

- **Document creation**: Create new `.docx` files in OneDrive with optional initial text content (4 MB upload limit).
- **Document retrieval**: Fetch a document's full content (returned as Markdown by default) or metadata only.
- **Document editing**: Append text to the end of existing `.docx` files (4 MB limit).
- **User context**: Retrieve information about the authenticated user and their Microsoft Word environment.

## OAuth

This toolkit uses OAuth 2.0 via **Microsoft**. Arcade handles the authorization flow automatically. See the [Microsoft auth provider docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/references/auth-providers/microsoft) for setup details.
